def factor_overnight_intraday_vol_shock_robust(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    divergence = overnight_ret - intraday_ret
    vol_weight = vol_ratio.clip(0.8, 1.6)
    signal = divergence * vol_weight
    factor = signal.rolling(10, min_periods=5).mean()
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_vol_shock_robust"] = factor.fillna(0.0)
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_vol_shock_robust"]
description: Mutation by threshold tightening and smoothing extension. The parent's core overnight-intraday liquidity divergence mechanism is preserved. To target robustness and reduce outlier sensitivity, the volume ratio is clipped to a narrower [0.8, 1.6] band so extreme volume spikes contribute less, and the smoothing window is extended from 5 to 10 days (min_periods=5) to lower turnover and improve stability. This keeps one core mechanism and one lightweight volume modifier; no new feature families are added. Cross-sectional z-score is retained because liquidity-shock magnitude is relative across assets.
